FEATURE GAP ANALYSIS: Hearthborn (read-only review of src/*.js, index.html, scratchpad/progress.md, spec.md and spec_ws.md, plus web comparison)

== 1. WHAT EXISTS (from the code) ==
- Core loop: hunger/thirst/warmth/stamina/health bars (updateStats in main.js). Food: berries, raw meat/fish (cannot be eaten raw: "must be cooked"), cooked meat, grilled fish, flatbread, drying rack. Water: river, well, waterskin. Heal: poultice (H). Warmth: fire, hut/house, cave, fur cloak, torch.
- Death is forgiving. die() in main.js (~L3090) always does "Sena carries you back to camp", then resets hp 60. There is no difficulty setting, no permadeath and no game-over.
- Combat: fists, axe, spear (melee and throw with an aim arc), torch, hitstop and shake. Enemies are only wolves (night pack event). Prey: deer, stag, fox, plus cows in the epilogue. HP table: deer 4, stag 6, wolf 6, fox 2. WPN explicitly made hits "dust/chip puffs (no blood)". Sena cannot be hurt.
- Weather: a single random "storm" event (rain lines, rain noise). No seasons, snow, fog or lightning. The clock only advances the day on sleep.
- Story: 12 wholesome chapters with goals and fixed dialogue (CH array). No choices, no antagonists, no loss, no branching. The VIGNETTES fire-side chats are all sweet.
- Relationship: one Closeness meter (0-100), from sitting at the fire, shared meals, flowers, handprints, carving, rest together and builds. There are no gifts with preferences, no physical affection actions (kiss/embrace) and no mood/conflict.
- Progression: tool tiers stone to flint only; horse bond levels. No player skills, XP or perks.
- World: caves, 11 POIs, fog-of-war parchment map, fords, lake, horses (tame/ride/whistle/stable), a co-op building system, home upgrades, farm, well, kiln, Lio (daughter) and the village epilogue.
- UI/meta: a pause menu with sensitivity, invert Y, quality, fullscreen, ONE master volume, auto-draw, shake and arc. The help panel is a large always-on key list (it also covers the weapon viewmodel area). Audio is 100% procedural WebAudio noise (wind, crickets, rain, river, chirps): no music at all. One save slot (Mongo/SQLite + localStorage). No gamepad, no achievements, no photo mode, no journal screen (just a line under the map), no loading progress (the title button just says "Loading…"), no tutorial beyond toasts.
- Available assets: Quaternius human male/female (+5 hair styles); animals cow/deer/fox/stag/wolf/horse/horse_white/donkey (the donkey is loaded but unused). UAL clips include Death01, Hit_Chest, Hit_Head, Roll, Sword_Attack and Punch. No bow, kiss or bandage clips, but the P0 shared base (samplePose/applyPose/ik2/addOverride in people.js) makes procedural poses cheap. The same Quaternius animal pack family very likely includes Husky/Shiba Inu/Alpaca/Bull models (verify before relying on them). No bear/boar/rabbit in the current set.

== 2. COMPARISON TAKEAWAYS (what the reference games do that Hearthborn lacks) ==
- Green Hell: typed wounds (lacerations bleed until bandaged), infection if ignored, parasites from unfiltered water and undercooked food, food poisoning from spoiled food, fever, sanity. https://Techraptor.net/gaming/guides/green-hell-medicine-and-healing-guide , https://www.gamepressure.com/green-hell/diseases/z2c85b , https://primagames.com/gaming/how-to-get-rid-of-food-poisoning-in-green-hell
- The Long Dark: afflictions (sprained ankle from falls/steep ground, cured by rest or bandage; dysentery from bad water; food poisoning; cabin fever). Difficulty presets (Pilgrim/Voyageur/Stalker/Interloper/Misery) plus Custom where each affliction can be toggled; permadeath. https://thelongdark.fandom.com/wiki/Afflictions , https://shacknews.com/article/127061/the-long-dark-review-pinnacle-of-survival?amphtml=1
- Kingdom Come: Deliverance: bleeding as damage-over-time stopped with bandages; food spoilage and lethal food poisoning; skills/perks that improve by use; save-limiting (Saviour Schnapps) as a hardcore lever. https://pcgamer.com/games/rpg/kingdom-come-deliverance-2-food-poisoning-digestive-potion-recipe , https://segmentnext.com/kingdom-come-deliverance-buffs-and-debuffs/
- Valheim: skills 1-100 that level by use; Rested buff scaled by comfort (Hearthborn already has homeliness/restTier, so it is halfway there); food that raises max health/stamina. https://mobalytics.gg/gamebase/guides/valheim-comfort-rested-guide
- Far Cry Primal: Beast Master (tame wolves/big cats as fighting pets, bait to tame); owl scouting; rival tribes (Udam, Izila) that attack on sight; village/hut upgrades unlocking crafting; bow, club, spear. https://en.wikipedia.com/wiki/Far_Cry_Primal , https://primagames.com/tips/how-get-owl-far-cry-primal
- Red Dead Redemption 2: honor/morality meter with consequences, camp morale, 4-level horse bonding (Hearthborn has this), tracking wounded prey by blood trail, pelt quality from clean kills. https://reddead.fandom.com/wiki/Honor , https://shacknews.com/article/108131/horse-bonding-grooming-and-reviving-red-dead-redemption-2?amphtml=1
- The Forest / Sons of the Forest: a hostile tribe with escalating behaviour, effigies, defensive traps that also catch animals, a companion command menu (follow/stay/gather/build), and permanent companion death; difficulty modes Peaceful/Normal/Hard/Hard Survival/Custom. https://www.gosunoob.com/sons-of-the-forest/how-to-command-kelvin-and-use-companion/ , https://pindrop.gg/the-forest/guides/cannibals
- Ancestors: The Humankind Odyssey: evolution/skill tree spent while resting, generations (the kids matter mechanically), a harsh learn-by-doing tone. https://shacknews.com/article/113641/get-neuronal-energy-in-ancestors-the-humankind-odyssey
- Zelda BotW/TotK: experimental cooking (combine up to 5 ingredients, emergent recipes, buff dishes for cold/heat/stamina), weather with real gameplay effects, compendium/photo collection. https://www.zeldadungeon.net/wiki/Breath_of_the_Wild_Recipes
- Stardew Valley: 28-day seasons gating crops/forage, festivals, gift likes/dislikes with weekly limits, heart events, romance milestones (bouquet to dating to marriage). https://stardewvalleywiki.com:443/Season , https://pcgamer.com/all-stardew-valley-characters-likes
- Browser controller support: Gamepad API is poll-based (read navigator.getGamepads() inside the rAF loop), standard mapping, deadzones, hot-plug events, about 96% support. https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Gamepad_API/Using_the_Gamepad_API

== 3. KEY GAPS VS THE USER'S 21+ DIRECTION ==
(a) Violence: no blood anywhere by design. All needed FX can be procedural (sprite particles, decal quads, screen-edge vignette); no new assets are needed.
(b) Harsh survival: no injuries, no illness, no spoilage, no difficulty, and death is a free rescue. These are the cheapest high-value wins, because die(), updateStats, eat() and the poultice already exist as hook points.
(c) Mature story: zero conflict, choices or loss. A rival tribe needs human enemies, which the existing makeHuman + UAL Sword_Attack/Punch/Death01/Hit clips + the wolfBrain pattern can provide without new models (distinct hair, ochre war-paint texture tint).
(d) Romance: Closeness exists, but there are no affection actions. Kiss/embrace can be done procedurally with ik2 + applyPose and a camShot, plus the existing fadeTo + rest sequence for "fade to black, wake at dawn". HARD LINE: keep everything non-explicit (no nudity, no sex scenes, cut away at the embrace/kiss and resume next morning). Add a content advisory/age screen with Blood and Mature Themes toggles.

== 4. RANKED LIST (impact ÷ cost for a browser game; details in proposals) ==
1 Difficulty presets + Custom + Permadeath (S/high)
2 Content advisory + mature settings (Blood off/reduced/full, Mature themes) (S/high)
3 Procedural blood & wound FX + prey blood trails (M/high)
4 Injury system: bleeding/sprain/fracture/infection + bandage/splint (M/high)
5 Illness: raw meat, dirty water, spoiled food + remedies + boiling (M/high)
6 Food spoilage + scarcity tuning (S/high)
7 Ambient/adaptive music score + split volume sliders (S-M/high)
8 Romance v2, non-explicit: embrace/kiss/hold hands, gifts with tastes, fade-to-black nights, moods/arguments (M/high)
9 Sena commands + Sena vulnerability (she can be wounded; can die on Hardcore) (M/high)
10 Rival tribe (raiders, camps, night raids) (L/high)
11 Mature story layer: choices with consequences, "Kinship" honor meter, loss beats, branching epilogue (M-L/high)
12 Onboarding: loading progress + tips, contextual hints replacing the help wall (S/med-high)
13 Seasons + weather cycle (snow, fog, thunderstorm/lightning, seasonal food) (M-L/high)
14 Cooking v2 with clay pot (stews, teas, broths, buff foods) (S-M/med-high)
15 Journal/codex screen (J) (S-M/medium)
16 Skills that improve by use + small perks (M/med-high)
17 Wolf-pup / dog companion (M/high)
18 Bow & arrows (M-L/high)
19 Accessibility & settings polish (FOV, subtitles, rebinding, toggle-vs-hold, HUD hide, colorblind) (S-M/medium)
20 Traps & snares (S-M/medium)
21 Achievements (S/medium)
22 Photo mode (S/medium)
23 Controller support (Gamepad API) (M/medium)
24 Tool durability + bone tier, from butchering (M/medium)
25 Multiple save slots / Hardcore single slot (S-M/medium)
26 Clothing layers + wetness (M/medium)
27 Dugout canoe/raft (M/medium)
28 Dynamic world events (wildfire, carrion, stampede, injured stranger) (M/medium)
29 Friendly tribe trading post / barter (L/medium)
30 New predators/fauna (cave bear boss, boar, small game): asset-dependent (M-L/medium)

== 5. IMPLEMENTATION NOTES / RISKS ==
- Suggested first batch (one WP, low conflict with the WPN/RST engineers): #1, #2, #4-#6 all hook into updateStats/eat/die/settings and add a body-status HUD row next to #buff. Then #3 (hooks into hurt() and wpnKnock, which WPN owns: coordinate). Then #8/#9/#11 as a story/relationship WP. #10 last (largest).
- Blood must respect settings.blood (off = current dust puffs). Use pooled sprites/decals (max ~64) to protect fps; the machine already runs at 5-20 fps under tests.
- Permadeath must reuse deleteGame() and show an obituary card (days survived, Closeness, Lio born, etc.). Story/Normal keep the current rescue, but with real costs (dropped items at the death spot, lost day, Closeness hit).
- Rival-tribe raids must never target Lio (the existing rule "wolves only target P" should carry over). Avoid violence toward the child entirely; threat can be implied (stolen stash, burned fence) rather than shown.
- Romance: implement as animation + camera cut + fadeTo; dialogue warm and adult in tone but not sexual. The pregnancy beat in 'newlife' is already off-screen and should stay that way.
- Ordering constraint: WPN owns hurt()/hit FX and RST owns rest/sleep. Romance fade-to-black nights and Hardcore rest rules should extend RST's API, not fork it.

violence.findings:
REALISTIC VIOLENCE DESIGN FOR HEARTHBORN (research + assets). I did not touch /home/ashish/Desktop/game.

=== 0. WHAT EXISTS TODAY (the hooks this design plugs into) ===
- hurt(o,dmg) is in main.js at about line 737. It calls wpnKnock (knockback, flinch, dust puff "no blood") and plays the 'Death' clip with 'hold' (clamps on the last frame). Animal HP is HP={deer:4,stag:6,wolf:6,fox:2,cow:60}.
- wolfBrain bite: S.hp-=6, hurtFlash, wpnBitten (shake). Only one wolf bites at a time (packBite).
- landHit / wpnHitFx: hitstop 0.045 to 0.12, trauma shake.
- Butcher is a 2.7 m prompt in findTarget. It hides the carcass at once.
- #hurt is a CSS radial red vignette.
- There is no postprocessing (no EffectComposer), and fps runs 14 to 40 on this machine, so every effect has to be cheap and pooled.
- Free keys: Alt, Z, I, middle mouse, and others. Used keys: Q (weapons), E, F (eat), X (whistle), V (view), G (auto-walk), C/Ctrl (sneak), B/Tab (menu), T, R, H, M.
- Settings rows are in index.html (lines 182 to 190) and are wired near main.js line 3607.
- UAL1 human clips (anims.glb) that are present but NOT yet loaded as actions: Hit_Chest, Hit_Head, Roll, Death01 (Death01 is pose-sample only).
- Animal clips: wolf/deer have Attack, Death, Idle_HitReact1/2, Gallop and Eating.
- three r187 facts I checked in node_modules:
  - DecalGeometry ignores skinning (it reads geometry.attributes.position raw), so it is only valid on static meshes.
  - Mesh.raycast on a SkinnedMesh IS skinned (getVertexPosition, then applyBoneTransform). The bounding sphere is cached, so null it before a ray.
  - Animals have NO UVs. The wolf/bull have only POSITION, NORMAL, JOINTS, WEIGHTS; the deer also has COLOR_0. The humans have TEXCOORD_0.
  - So wounds must not depend on texture painting. Use the bind-space shader below.

=== 1. ASSETS FOUND AND DOWNLOADED (each in its own new dir under scratchpad/assets2/, inspected only with scratchpad/tools/gltfinfo2.py and pp.sh run with python -I) ===

=== 3. BLOOD VFX: CONCRETE three.js TECHNIQUES (new file src/gore.js) ===
3.1 Blood particles: ONE InstancedMesh, pool of 384, one draw call.
- Geometry: IcosahedronGeometry(1,0), or a 4-vertex quad with a droplet alpha. Material: MeshLambertMaterial({color:0x5a0606}), with instanceColor for per-drop shade.
- Per-instance state lives in Float32Arrays: pos, vel, life, size.
- Integrate every frame: gravity 9.8, drag 0.8. Scale each instance along its velocity (a streak) with a matrix built from lookAt(vel) and scale (s, s, s+|v|*0.04).
- When it hits the ground (y < getHeight(x,z)), spawn a ground splat with p=0.35 and recycle the drop.
- Burst profile bloodBurst(pos, dir, n, speed):
  - a cone of about 35 degrees around (hit normal + attacker forward), speed 2 to 5 m/s;
  - n = 6 / 14 / 28 by gore low / med / high, doubled on a kill or a heavy blow;
  - plus 1 to 3 'mist' sprites reusing the existing puffTex tinted 0x7a0c0c, lasting 0.25 s (the Ghost of Tsushima mist).
- Arterial spurt on lethal neck/heart hits: 3 to 5 pulses at 0.35 s intervals from a point that follows the wound (see 3.4).
3.2 Ground splats on the terrain: ONE InstancedMesh, pool 160, of PlaneGeometry(1,1) laid flat.
- Do not use DecalGeometry here: the terrain is a large heightfield, and DecalGeometry walks every triangle of the target mesh.
- Align each quad to the terrain normal: sample getHeight at ±0.3 m and take the cross product. Set y = h + 0.02, with polygonOffset (factor -2, units -4) and depthWrite false.
- Alpha atlas: a CanvasTexture of 2x2 procedurally drawn splats (noisy circles plus satellite droplets), 256 px. Use an instance attribute aTile plus aAge, through onBeforeCompile.
- Ageing: wet 0x4a0606, roughness 0.3 (it glints), drying to 0x2a0d08 over 120 s, then fading. Rain (world.env.storm) speeds up the fade 4x.
- Pooling is FIFO. A splat's scale grows over 0.5 to 6 s for pools under corpses.
- The same pool draws trail drops (scale 0.08 to 0.18).
3.3 Decals on static meshes: DecalGeometry from three/addons/geometries/DecalGeometry.js.
- Targets: structure walls (hut/house), the cave dome and tube, landmark stones, tree trunks.
- Only use non-instanced meshes under about 30k tris. For InstancedMesh rocks or trees, either skip or build a temporary Mesh with that instance's matrix.
- On a heavy hit or a kill, raycast 1 to 3 rays from the victim along the blow direction, rotated by ±25 degrees, within 2.5 m.
- On a hit: new DecalGeometry(mesh, point, Euler from the normal, size 0.35 to 0.9). Use the shared splat material (polygonOffset, alphaTest 0.3) and a cap of 24 decals, FIFO with geometry.dispose().
- Build the decal on the next frame (queue it) to avoid a hitch on the hit frame.
3.4 Wounds on skinned bodies, animals and humans alike: a "bind-space wound sphere" shader. No texture painting is needed (animals have no UVs).
- patchWoundMaterial(mat) uses onBeforeCompile:
  - Vertex: after #include <begin_vertex>, store `vBind = position;`. This is the pre-skinning bind position.
  - Fragment: uniform vec4 uW[8] (xyz bind-space centre, w radius) and float uWet[8].
  - For each wound: m = 1 - smoothstep(0.55*r, r, d + (hash3(vBind*37.)-.5)*0.4*r), where d = distance(vBind, uW[i].xyz).
  - Then diffuseColor.rgb = mix(diffuseColor.rgb, mix(vec3(.16,.01,.01), vec3(.32,.02,.02), wet), m*uGore), and roughnessFactor = mix(roughnessFactor, .25, m*wet).
  - Add a darker core (m2 with 0.4*r) as the wound itself.
- Placing a wound from a world hit point, two ways:
  - (a) Player hits, precise: raycast the body SkinnedMesh (set mesh.boundingSphere = null first). Recompute the barycentre with Triangle.getBarycoord on getVertexPosition(a/b/c), then bindPos = the barycentric sum of the RAW attribute positions.
  - (b) Cheap, for AI bites: take the nearest bone B to the point. Then p_bind = bindMatrixInverse⁻¹... In practice that is p_bind = inv(boneInverses[B])⁻¹ ... implement it as p_bind = (bindMatrix⁻¹ · boneInverses[B]⁻¹ · B.matrixWorld⁻¹ · mesh.matrixWorld) applied to the mesh-local point. This is exact for a vertex rigidly weighted to B.
- Radius in bind units = r_world / mesh.matrixWorld.getMaxScaleOnAxis(). The new GLBs carry ×100 armature scale, so this conversion is needed.
- The 8 slots are FIFO, and wounds stay until revive or remove.
- Drips: keep {bone, boneLocalOffset} per wound and spawn a drip every 0.3 to 1 s while bleeding.
- Bloody hands after butchering: in the vertex shader, sum skinWeight where skinIndex is one of the hand, lowerarm or finger joint indices (passed as a uniform int list, or precompute a vertex attribute aHand once at load). Pass it as a varying and mix with blood × uHandsBlood (0..1), which decays in water (P.swim or river depth) and slowly over time.
- Rival-tribe war paint uses the same patch with a uPaint vec4 array in ochre/black (stripes are just elongated spheres, or bands on the bind-space y axis), so no new textures.
3.5 Screen-space feedback (DOM, no composer):
- Turn #hurt into three layers.
  - (1) The existing radial vignette, with a heartbeat pulse when hp < 35: opacity follows a 70 to 110 bpm curve, plus a low A.tone thump.
  - (2) A canvas #splat that draws 3 to 6 pre-rendered splatter sprites at the screen edge facing the attacker (angle = attacker bearing minus the camera yaw). They slide down 30 px over 2 s and fade; hits from behind splatter the bottom.
  - (3) Bleeding status: a slow red edge pulse plus a HUD blood-drop icon with the wound count.
- Low-HP desaturation: renderer.domElement.style.filter = saturate(.4+.6*hp/35), only on 'high' quality, since a CSS filter costs a compositor pass.
3.6 Sounds through the existing synth A:
- flesh impact: low-passed noise at 400 Hz plus a pitch-drop thump at 140→70 Hz;
- bone crack: a 2 kHz click;
- spatter: band noise at 1.5 to 3 kHz, 60 ms;
- arterial: 3 pulses;
- butcher squelch: low-passed noise with a 300 ms envelope.

=== 4. TRACKING WOUNDED PREY (RDR2 / Far Cry Primal) ===
- Hit zones come from the hit point in the animal's local frame (root.worldToLocal):
  - head/neck: front 25% and upper half. ×3 damage; usually a clean kill. A deer dies or drops within 3 s.
  - heart/lung: front-mid and lower. ×2 damage; bleed 0.5 hp/s; a short trail; dies in 15 to 40 s.
  - gut/hindquarter: ×0.8 damage; bleed 0.08 hp/s; a long trail; dies in 2 to 4 min.
  - leg: low y. Speed ×0.6 (limp: play Walk with timeScale 0.7 and a periodic root roll).
- The wounded animal flees, slows as hp falls, and then "beds down" in cover (pick a landSpot in forest 60 to 150 m away). Bedding down is Idle_Headlow or Eating, then the Death clip paused at t≈0.35, giving a lying pose.
- Approaching while sneaking gives "End its suffering (E)": a mercy kill with a short animation. Approaching loudly makes it bolt again.
- Trail drops: every lerp(2.5, 0.8, bleed) m travelled, put a ground splat (small, 1 to 3 drops) plus an occasional smear on brush. Store the trail id so the drops can be highlighted.
- Hunter's Focus (hold Z): walk at sneak speed; trail drops within 40 m get an emissive red boost through instanceColor (×4) plus a soft pulse; the last-seen direction arrow; Sena says "It's bleeding, this way".
- Blood Off mode: the same trail drawn as brown 'scuffed grass/hoofprints', so the mechanic survives.
- Hide quality (RDR2 stars): clean (one hit to head or heart, or a thrown spear from 12 m or more) gives a Prime hide (+1 hide, better cloak warmth). Many hits, or an axe to the body, gives a Poor hide.

=== 5. HIT REACTIONS, DEATH POSES, RAGDOLL-LITE ===
- Humans:
  - Load Hit_Chest, Hit_Head and Roll (UAL1) as SHOTS, plus Hit_Knockback, Idle_Shield_Break, Sword_Block and LayToIdle (UAL2).
  - Choose by zone: head gives Hit_Head; torso gives Hit_Chest; a heavy blow gives Hit_Knockback with a 1.2 m slide; a posture break gives Idle_Shield_Break.
  - Add a procedural directional flinch override at order 40: spine_02/03 and the head get an impulse spring toward the hit direction (k=120, damping 14). Hits then read even mid-swing (the Mount & Blade feel).
- Animals: Idle_HitReact1/2 for the wolf/deer, Idle_HitReact_Left/Right for the bull (by side), plus the existing wpnAnimalFx flinch and knockback.
- Death:
  - (1) Clip with 'hold' (exists).
  - (2) For humans, before playing Death01, yaw the root so its fall direction lines up with the blow.
  - (3) Terrain conform after the clip ends: sample getHeight at the head and tail (±0.6·length along the root forward) and both sides. Build the plane normal and slerp the root's up to it over 0.3 s, so corpses lie flat on slopes.
  - (4) Death slide: keep integrating the kb velocity with friction during the first 0.4 s.
  - (5) Corpse reactions (RDR2): when a corpse is hit, add a spine/head spring impulse plus a small blood puff.
  - (6) The morph-target bear/lion has no Death clip. Freeze the morph frame, then topple: roll angle θ with θ'' = 9·sin(θ+0.1), up to 85 degrees, about the forward axis at the body's side, then terrain conform.
- No physics ragdoll (no physics engine; budget). Optional secondary motion: for 1 s after death, a spring-damped lag on the head and arm bones.

=== 6. KILL FINISHERS (Ghost of Tsushima / TLOU / Far Cry Primal) ===
- Triggers: posture broken (stagger), prey bedded or downed, a human knocked down, or a stealth approach from behind while undetected.
- Prompt: E, "Finish". Both actors go busy. The victim snaps to attacker + forward·0.95, facing the attacker (or facing away for stealth). Use the existing camShot hook: a side camera 2.2 m away at FOV 45. Time scale 0.35 for 0.25 s at impact.
- Aro's moves by weapon:
  - spear: a downward thrust (the existing procedural thrust, pelvis lowered);
  - axe: Sword_Regular_C overhead;
  - fists, humans only: Melee_Hook then Punch_Cross;
  - stealth: a spear through the back, or the axe.
- Impact frame:
  - 2 blood bursts plus a wound at the neck or chest;
  - hitstop 0.15, bone crack plus flesh sound;
  - victim: Hit_Head then Death01 (human) or HitReact then Death (animal);
  - a corpse pool grows.
- Gore setting:
  - Low: the camera cuts away to Sena or the sky at impact.
  - Off: dust, no wounds.
  - "Finisher camera" toggle off: no cut, no slow-mo.
- Spear brace (Mount & Blade / real boar-spear):
  - Holding RMB with the spear while a charger (boar, bear, aurochs) is within 6 m in the front 50-degree cone shows "Brace!".
  - On contact: 40 to 60 damage, then stagger or an instant boar kill, and a finisher camera.

=== 7. COMBAT SYSTEM (harder, stamina-driven) ===
- Stamina costs: light attack 10, heavy 22, dodge 18, block absorbs dmg×1.5 of stamina. At 0 the guard breaks: 1 s stagger.
- Regen 18/s after a 0.8 s delay. Below 20% stamina: swings ×0.8 speed, plus heavy breathing.
- Light combo: chain LMB with a 0.25 s input buffer.
  - axe: Sword_Regular_A, B, C (UAL2);
  - spear: jab, jab, thrust;
  - fists: jab, cross, Melee_Hook.
- Heavy: hold LMB 0.4 s. Use Sword_Attack slowed then fast, or the first slam of Sword_Heavy_Combo. Posture ×2, breaks blocks.
- Block: hold RMB with the axe, fists or torch. The spear keeps RMB for aim and brace.
  - The pose is a Sword_Block sampled mid-frame as an upper-body override (the same samplePose/WPOSE technique as the WPN stance).
  - It covers the front 120 degrees only. Damage reduction: axe 80%, fists 50%.
- Parry: block pressed within 0.18 s before an enemy hit lands.
  - Effect: the enemy staggers, takes big posture damage, 0.2 s slow-mo, a stone/wood clack.
  - It also knocks back wolf lunges.
- Dodge/roll: Left Alt (fullscreen already keeps Alt), with Z as a fallback.
  - The UAL1 Roll clip, in the movement direction (or backward). i-frames 0.10 to 0.40 s.
  - A perfect dodge (within 0.15 s of impact) gives 0.4 s slow-mo and a counter window.
- Telegraphs (Ghost of Tsushima glints): every enemy attack has a 0.35 to 0.6 s windup and a sprite glint at the weapon or jaws. White means parryable; red means unblockable (bear swipe, boar charge, tribe heavy overhead), so dodge.
- Posture meter (Sekiro/Valheim) on enemies: hits and parries fill it; full means stagger and the finisher prompt; it regenerates when they are not hit.
- Soft lock-on: middle mouse. Strafe facing extends from wolves to all hostiles.
- Anti-spam (Kingdom Come): each enemy keeps a count of the last 3 player attack types, and its block chance rises 20% per repeat.
- Throwables: stones, using OverhandThrow (UAL2). They do damage and also make noise that lures enemies (TLOU bottle).
- Player wounds (they feed the hardcore system):
  - Each wound is {part: bone, type: bite|claw|cut|puncture|gore, sev 1..3, bleed hp/s 0.05/0.15/0.35, bandaged}.
  - Severity 1 clots in 60 s. Severity 2 or 3 needs a bandage (new: hide strip, optionally plus herbs) or the poultice. Severity 3 untreated carries an infection risk.
  - A bandage shows as an open CylinderGeometry hide band parented to the bone.
  - Wolf bites go from 6 to 10 damage, with a 35% chance of a sev1 bleed.
  - Inspect screen (I): a close orbit camera and the wound list, with Treat buttons (Green Hell).
  - If Sena is near, she binds your wound: a tender moment, +2 Closeness.

- Steering: reuse step(), collide() and avoid (open terrain, no navmesh needed). Tribesmen never enter caves.
- Encounters: scouting pairs (they steal from the stash or the drying rack), an ambush at a ford, a war band camp at night (stealth takedowns), a raid on the home at night that Sena helps defend.
- Sena in combat: she throws stones and her spear. She can be DOWNED but never killed outside a story beat; revive with E or a poultice within 60 s (TLOU/RDR2).
- Hard rule: Lio (the child) and any children are never targetable, never harmed and never in combat. Children in story beats are always moved out of combat.

=== 10. BUTCHERING WITH BLOOD (RDR2) ===
- Hold E: 2.5 s for small game, 4 s for big. Aro kneels (pose 'work'), with a close camShot.
- 3 cuts using strikeU at timeScale 1.2 with the spear tip, the axe, or a new flint knife. Each cut: a 6-drop spurt plus a squelch.
- A pool grows under the carcass from 0.2 to 1.2 over 6 s.
- The carcass is NOT hidden: its Main/Main_Light materials are swapped to a skinned-muscle look (0x7a2620, roughness 0.45), the eyes go dark, and the model scale goes ×0.9. It stays for 120 s as scavenger bait, then fades.
- Aro gets bloody hands (uHandsBlood=1), which wash off in the river.
- Blood Off: the same flow with dust and no colour swap. Low gore: the camera stays wide.

=== 11. SETTINGS, AGE GATE AND SAFETY ===
- Settings rows, stored in the settings object from save.js:
  - Blood: On/Off.
  - Gore intensity: Low/Medium/High. This sets the particle multiplier (0.4/1/1.8), splat size (0.7/1/1.3), the wound radius and darkness (uGore 0.5/0.8/1) and corpse-pool size. Low also cuts away during finishers.
  - Screen blood effects: On/Off.
  - Finisher camera and slow-motion: On/Off.
  - Kill-cam on hunting: On/Off.
- First launch of the 21+ build: a content-warning age gate ("Blood and gore, intense violence, mature themes, suggestive themes (non-explicit)"), plus "I am 21+ / Use toned-down mode". Toned-down mode sets Blood Off and Low gore.
- Hard limits: no dismemberment or decapitation (the assets do not support it, and it is not needed for an M-rating feel); no torture; no violence to children; no lingering on human suffering.
- Human enemies get the same blood as animals, but finishers on surrendered humans happen only by explicit player choice.

=== 12. PERFORMANCE BUDGET ===
- 3 instanced draw calls in total: drops (384), ground splats (160), ravens.
- Static decals: 24 or fewer. Wound shader: 8 vec4 uniforms per material.
- Skinned raycast only on player-hit frames. That is about 7.3k vertices for the human body; the bone approximation is used everywhere else.
- No new lights and no allocations per hit (preallocated Vector3/Matrix4).
- All of it is gated by quality: on 'low', halve the pools and skip DecalGeometry.

=== 13. INTEGRATION MAP (for the implementer) ===
- New src/gore.js:
  - initGore(scene, getHeight)
  - bloodBurst(pos, dir, n, opts)
  - groundSplat(x, z, size, kind)
  - staticDecal(hit, dir)
  - patchWoundMaterial(mat)
  - addWound(model, worldPt, rWorld, opts)
  - bleedTick(o, dt)
  - screenSplat(angle, amt)
  - setGore(cfg)
  - updateGore(dt)
- New src/combat.js: stamina costs, block/parry/dodge, posture, zones, finishers, brace.
- New src/enemies.js: the bear/boar/cat/aurochs/alpha brains, tribe FSM and perception.
- main.js changes:
  - hurt(o, dmg) becomes hurt(o, dmg, {from, kind, point, zone});
  - wpnKnock gains blood when blood is on;
  - wolfBrain's bite goes through playerHurt({dmg, kind:'bite', from:o});
  - findTarget's butcher becomes butcherSeq;
  - HP, SCALE and LOOT gain the new kinds;
  - EVENTS gains bear, cat_stalk, raid and scouts;
  - die() clears wounds.
- people.js: add Hit_Chest, Hit_Head and Roll to SHOTS, plus a second anims2.glb (UAL2 subset) loaded the same way.
- animals.js: SCALE/EXT for bull, bear and lion (glb). A morph-model wrapper with no skeleton returns the same {play, busy, update} API with procedural states.
- Credits: add "Running Brown/Black Bear, Mountain Lion, Black Panther: Google Data Arts Team, CC-BY 3.0, via poly.pizza" and "Universal Animation Library 2, Bull: Quaternius CC0" (plus "Boar: OpenGameArt, CC0" if it is used).

Tools I used, kept outside the assets: .../scratchpad/tools/gltfinfo2.py (clips, bones, size, bbox, morph), .../scratchpad/tools/pp.sh (poly.pizza search to licence, animated flag, tris and GLB URL), and pp_anim.txt, posters.png and oga.png (preview sheets). The itch cookie jar and the HTML dumps are deleted.
Sources: quaternius.com (pack list), quaternius.itch.io/universal-animation-library-2, poly.pizza model pages listed above, opengameart.org/content/boar, opengameart.org/content/low-poly-bear, wizardhatstudio.itch.io/stoneage-wild-hunt.

survival.findings:
HARSH SURVIVAL / HARDCORE DESIGN for Hearthborn (read-only review of /home/ashish/Desktop/game/src/main.js and the spec/progress notes; nothing edited)

== 0. WHAT EXISTS TODAY (ground truth from the code) ==
- Stats in fresh() (main.js:43): hp, food, water, warm, stam, close, rested/restTier. updateStats (main.js:3767): food drains 0.085/s (x1.7 sprinting), water 0.12/s, warmth falls at night or in storms when not sheltered (chill 1.1, +1.5 in water, x0.5 cloak, x0.75 torch), and rises +5/s when sheltered. hp regenerates +0.7/s when food and water are above 35. At 0, each stat drains hp at 0.9/1.3/1.4 per second.
- Damage to the player: a wolf bite is -6 (main.js:769) and a horse kick while taming is -5 (main.js:452). There is no fall damage and no injury state.
- eat() (2197): cooked +45 food and +12 hp, grilled +35/+8, bread +30, berries +9. Raw meat or fish cannot be eaten at all. Cooking at the fire (2112) is instant. The rack (2124) turns raw food into cooked/grilled after 90 s. heal() (2216): poultice +35 hp. The waterskin holds 3 drinks, refilled at the river or the well. Nothing tracks water quality.
- die() (3090): always "Sena carries you back", then hp 60, food 55, +1 day. Nothing is lost.
- Respawns: animals 80 s after looting (1925), nodes NODE[k][2] (berries 170 s), trees 420 s.
- Settings live in save.js `settings` and are shown in the pause menu (3596). The title screen has only #btn-continue and #btn-new. There is no difficulty selection anywhere.
- Hooks a hardcore layer can attach to: the wolf bite (769), the horse kick (452), drinking at the river (1964) and the well (2152), eat (2197), drinkSkin (2210), heal (2216), cook (2112), the rack (2124-2133), updateStats (3767), die (3090), save S.* (285) and the load path, rest outcome (2957: hp +6/h, restTier), the hot spring soak (2005), the basket stash, S.seen fog grid, `hostileNear`, and the WPN aim/charge.

== 1. DIFFICULTY MODES ==
Chosen in a modal after "New game" on the title screen. Stored as S.diff = {mode, perma, blood, opts:{aff, spoil, fatigue, dread, nutrition}}. You can always move down from Survivor to Story in the pause menu. Hardcore is locked to its run. Lowering it ends the run's memorial eligibility and marks it "softened".

| Setting | STORY | SURVIVOR (default) | HARDCORE |
|---|---|---|---|
| Food / water drain | x0.75 | x1.0 | x1.3 |
| Cold (chill) | x0.75 | x1.0 | x1.4, plus Wet |
| Wolf damage / pack size | x0.6 / 2 | x1.0 / 3 | x1.6 / 3-5 |
| Afflictions | off (cosmetic bleed that stops by itself in 10 s) | on, gentle, cannot kill on their own (hp floor 10) | on, full, can kill |
| Spoilage | off | slow | fast |
| Fatigue / Dread | off | on, mild | on |
| Nutrition | variety buff only | variety buff only | buff plus imbalance penalties |
| Berry / herb respawn (170 s base) | x0.8 | x1.3 | x2.2 |
| Animal respawn (80 s base) | 60 s | 150 s | 300 s, herd cap -40% |
| Meat per deer | 2 | 2 | 1 (stag 2) |
| Sena revive (Downed) | always | always | once per game day, needs a bandage or poultice in your pack |
| Death | current behaviour | rescue with a penalty | permadeath, memorial and legacy |
| Saves | free | free | one slot, autosave only, quitting saves, the save is deleted on death |

Survivor death penalty: lose all carried raw and cooked food and half the fibre and berries. Wake with "Weakened" (stamina cap 70, hp regen x0.5 for 1 game day). Sena says a worried line. Closeness is unchanged.
Grace periods: Survivor has no afflictions during the awaken and fire chapters (the tutorial). Hardcore has only the first game day as grace.

== 2. AFFLICTIONS ==
Six body parts: head, torso, armL, armR, legL, legR. State S.aff = [{id, part, sev 1-3, t (game hours), tr (treated flag), risk}].
Two helper functions:
- addAff(id, part, sev, why) shows a toast plus a card the first time each affliction appears.
- affMods() returns {speed, stamCap, stamRegen, foodK, waterK, chillK, warmGainK, aimWobble, noSprint, noJump, noTwoHand, regenK}. updatePlayer, updateStats and the WPN aim read it.
Timers run in game hours so that sleep and rest move them forward.

a) BLEEDING (DayZ / Long Dark)
- Causes: a wolf bite (chance 25% Survivor, 50% Hardcore; sev 2 if the bite lands at hp below 40); a stag antler charge on Hardcore; a fall over 4 m; pulling a leech off by hand (sev 1).
- Effect: sev 1 drains -0.15 hp/s, sev 2 -0.5 hp/s. Blood drips on the ground (only with Blood on). Wolves notice you from twice as far.
- Cure: a Fibre bandage stops sev 1. Sev 2 needs a Hide bandage or a Yarrow poultice. Sev 1 stops by itself after 60 s on Survivor and never on Hardcore.
- Next stage: once the bleeding stops it becomes a WOUND.

b) WOUND -> INFECTION (Long Dark infection risk)
- A wound carries an "infection risk" ring that fills over 12 game hours unless you clean it. Ways to clean it:
  - boiled water: hold E on the wound in the body screen at a fire with a pot
  - any poultice
  - Sena tends it
- Risk at the end: 35% Survivor, 70% Hardcore.
- INFECTION effect: fever (warmth swings ±15 every few minutes), hp regen off, stamina cap -30. Survivor caps the hp loss at -0.05/s with a floor of 20. Hardcore has no floor after 2 days.
- Cure: 2 Yarrow/Willow poultices 12 h apart, plus rest.
- The existing poultice changes:
  - Story: +35 hp, as now.
  - Survivor/Hardcore: +20 hp, cleans a wound and stops sev 1 bleeding. It is also one infection dose.

c) SPRAIN, ankle or wrist (Long Dark)
- Causes:
  - landing from a drop over 2.5 m
  - sprinting downhill on a slope over 35° with stamina under 20 (chance 2%/s)
  - being thrown by a horse during a failed taming
  - for the wrist: chopping with fists or a stone axe at stamina 0
- Effect, ankle: speed x0.7, no sprint, no jump, a limp anim (blend a slower walk with a dip).
- Effect, wrist: axe/spear swing dmg -40%, throw charge time x1.5.
- Cure: heals in 1 game day (4 h of sleep counts as 8). A splint/wrap halves the time and removes the no-sprint penalty.

d) FRACTURE, leg or arm (DayZ broken legs). Hardcore only; Survivor turns it into a sev 2 sprain.
- Causes: a fall over 6 m (Lookout Peak cliffs, ravines), being thrown at a gallop, a stag charge at low hp.
- Effect, leg: speed x0.35, no sprint or jump, constant pain vignette. Effect, arm: two-handed spear stance and the axe are disabled (fists and torch only).
- Cure: a splint (2 sticks + 2 fibre, or a hide wrap) makes it heal (3 game days). Without a splint, 5% per game hour to "heal badly": a permanent -10% speed scar until the epilogue.
- Mobility aids:
  - Hold E on Sena: "Lean on Sena" (both walk at x0.6). This reuses the WP1 pose system and is a strong co-op moment.
  - Riding the horse ignores leg penalties.

e) FOOD POISONING (Long Dark)
- Causes: eating raw meat or fish (a new hold-F "Eat raw" option: +20 food, 40/60% chance); spoiled food (70/90%); undercooked meat taken off the spit early (25%); bitter berries (see 6).
- Onset: 1-2 game hours.
- Effect for 12 game hours: vomiting episodes every ~90 s (screen sway, -10 food, -12 water, a stop-in-place anim), stamina cap 50.
- Cure: rest plus water. Mint tea cuts the remaining time by 60%.

f) DYSENTERY (Long Dark)
- Causes: unsafe water. Drinking from Mirror Lake shallows, marsh pools or the river downstream of the village or carcasses is 15% Survivor / 30% Hardcore. Plain river water is 0% Survivor / 8% Hardcore. Well water and boiled water are always safe.
- The waterskin remembers its source (S.skinQ = 'safe' | 'raw'), shown on the HUD chip as "Waterskin 2/3 (river)".
- Effect for 1.5 game days: water drain x2.5, food drain x1.5, stamina cap 60.
- Cure: 4 drinks of boiled water plus rest, or mint tea.

g) PARASITES (Green Hell worms / Long Dark intestinal parasites). Hardcore only.
- Cause: a hidden counter. Each raw or undercooked meal, and each piece of wolf meat (new on Hardcore), adds risk. Past 4 points there is a 50% chance per day.
- Effect: food drain x1.4, max hp -5 per day (floor 60).
- Cure: 5 doses of Bitter root (wormwood) tea, one per day.

h) HYPOTHERMIA (Long Dark: risk, then affliction)
- A "Hypothermia risk" bar fills while warmth stays under 20. It takes 90 game minutes on Survivor and 45 on Hardcore to fill.
- Effect when afflicted: stamina cap 50, warmth gain halved, hp -0.1/s while warmth is under 20.
- Cure: 10 game hours sheltered by a fire, sleeping Snug at home, or the hot spring (the spring cures it in 2 game hours, which gives the spring a survival purpose).

i) WET (Valheim)
- Causes: rain outside shelter, swimming, wading through fords, spear fishing.
- S.wet goes 0-100. Chill x1.8 while wet. Dries 3x faster within 8 m of a fire. A cloak only dries slowly.

j) LEECHES (Green Hell). Survivor and Hardcore, optional toggle.
- Cause: wading or swimming in Mirror Lake reeds and marsh fords. 10% chance per 10 s in water.
- They appear on a leg in the body screen and drain -0.03 hp/s.
- Removal: pull one by hand (minor bleed), or hold a lit torch to it (no bleed). The torch method is a fun use of the existing torch.

k) FATIGUE, a new bar (Long Dark / Zomboid tiredness)
- Rises from 0 to 100 over ~1.5 game days awake. It rises faster when sick, sprinting or chopping.
- Effects: over 70 the stamina cap is -25%. Over 90 you get blink-to-black micro-sleeps and Sena nags "You need sleep."
- Sleeping, sitting at the fire and the hot spring lower it. The existing rest tiers (Well rested / Snug) clear it, then hold it at 0 for their duration.
- Story mode: off.

l) DREAD / FEAR (Green Hell sanity, Ancestors fear, Zomboid panic)
- Gain:
  - at night away from any light (fire, torch, hearth)
  - in caves without a torch
  - x1.5 in tiles not yet uncovered on the map (reuse the S.seen fog grid)
  - after a wolf attack (+15)
  - while Sena is more than 40 m away at night
- Drain:
  - near light or near Sena (strong)
  - sitting together at the fire (-40)
  - Echo Hollow paintings (calm)
  - dancing, sleeping
- Closeness 60 or more halves gain. This ties the romance and closeness meters to survival.
- Effects:
  - over 50: a heartbeat sound, whispers, a vignette, false wolf eye-shine in the trees
  - over 80: aim wobble (the WPN arc sways), stamina regen -30%, and Sena comforts you unprompted
- The design never fakes damage, so this stays atmospheric rather than unfair.

m) PAIN (Zomboid), a derived symptom, not a separate affliction
- Sources: sprain, fracture, infection, bleeding.
- Effect: a pulsing screen edge and slightly slower turning.
- Willow bark tea suppresses it for 6 h.

Caps against tedium: at most 3 active afflictions on Survivor; no more than one new affliction per 10 game minutes; every icon tooltip says the cause and the cure in one line.

== 3. HUD (Project Zomboid "moodles" plus Long Dark status) ==
- A row of 26 px round icons under #bars in index.html. Each has a severity ring (yellow, orange, red), a draining arc for "time left" or "risk filling", and pulses when it gets worse.
- Icons: blood drop (bleed), bandaged cut (wound), red cut with a halo (infection), ankle (sprain), broken bone (fracture), stomach (poisoning), stomach with droplets (dysentery), worm (parasites), snowflake (hypothermia risk / afflicted), water drops (wet), leech, eye with lid (fatigue), dark eye (dread), lightning (pain).
- New bars appear only in modes that use them: Fatigue and Dread. Dread is shown only as an icon plus the vignette, because a bar for fear kills fear.
- Hover the icon (or open the body screen) for the tooltip.
- New items show a freshness sliver in the inventory.
- Blood setting OFF: drips, decals and the red tint become dark brown or neutral, and the bleed icon becomes a grey "wound open" glyph. Every mechanic stays the same.

== 4. BODY INSPECT SCREEN (Green Hell inspection, simplified) ==
- Key B (H stays the quick poultice).
- A parchment overlay in the same style as the map. Left: a front/back paper-doll silhouette of Aro with clickable regions. Right: the list for the selected part with timers and buttons: Bandage, Splint, Poultice, Clean with boiled water, Pull leech, Burn leech (needs a lit torch), Eat/drink herbs.
- It also shows the temperature readout ("Feels: Cold / Chilly / Mild / Warm / Hot" with the contributing factors: night, wet, wind, cloak layers, fire), the nutrition pips, fatigue, and warmth/wet.
- Treatments are a 1.5-2.5 s hold with Aro's swing('pick') anim.
- Pause: Story and Survivor pause the game. Hardcore runs at real time like Green Hell, so you treat wounds in a safe spot.
- Phase 2: a camShot close-up of Aro's forearm or leg with a decal of the wound or bandage. The WP rest system already has camShot, so this is a later polish item.
- Sena: hold E on her for "Ask Sena to tend you". She treats faster and better (bandage plus clean in one go; a splint takes no fibre if she carries one), +1 Closeness once a day, with a line. On Hardcore Sena can be bitten too, and you bandage her (+2 Closeness). These are mature caring beats, and the romance/closeness systems feed directly into survival.

== 5. CURES, NEW ITEMS AND RECIPES (chapter gating keeps them reachable early) ==
- Fibre bandage: fibre 3 (fire chapter). Stops sev 1 bleeding.
- Hide bandage: hide 1, fibre 1 (hunt). Stops sev 2 and halves infection risk.
- Splint: stick 2, fibre 2 (fire), or hide wrap. Treats sprains and fractures.
- Herbs (new gather nodes, same field system as berries/reeds):
  - Yarrow, white flowers in meadows: clotting and poultice.
  - Willow bark, from willow trees on the riverbank (E with axe): pain and fever.
  - Mint, by streams: stomach.
  - Bitter root (wormwood), near the ruins and the standing stones: parasites.
  - Old-man's-beard moss, in pine forest: a bandage that also cleans.
  - Bitter berries: a red lookalike of the berry bush (poisoning) that teaches players to look carefully. Sena warns "Not those." the first time.
- Water boiling, in two tiers (the prehistoric method is the authentic one):
  1. Hunt chapter: "Hide boiling bag", hide 1 + fibre 2. At a fire, "Boil water (hot stones)" fills the waterskin with safe water in 20 s.
  2. Clay chapter: "Clay pot", clay 3, fired at the fire. 8 s, holds 3, and unlocks teas (mint, willow, bitter root, yarrow = herb + boiled water).
- Yarrow poultice: yarrow 2 + fibre 1. Stops heavy bleeding and is one infection dose.
- Cooking thoroughly (Ancestors / Green Hell):
  - Survivor and Hardcore replace the instant cook with a spit at the fire. A 12 s bar runs raw, then undercooked (red), then cooked (green, 8 s window), then burnt (black: +10 food, no risk).
  - Taking it early gives "undercooked" (25% poisoning, parasite risk).
  - A "Cook all" option leaves pieces on the spit and lets you walk away (they burn if you wander off for too long).
  - Story keeps the instant cook.
- Drying rack becomes the preservation path:
  - It now yields a new item "Dried meat" / "Dried fish" (+30 food, never spoils, light) instead of cooked.
  - Survivor/Hardcore: drying is 3 game hours, the rack must not be rained on (a storm pauses it), and wolves can steal from it at night unless a fence is within 6 m (gives fences a purpose).

== 6. FOOD SPOILAGE AND NUTRITION ==
Store per-unit ages: S.age = {meat:[h...], fish:[...], cooked, grilled, berry, bread}, FIFO, with eat() taking the oldest unit first.

Spoil times in game hours (Survivor / Hardcore):
| Food | Survivor | Hardcore |
|---|---|---|
| raw meat | 24 | 12 |
| raw fish | 12 | 8 |
| cooked meat | 72 | 48 |
| grilled fish | 48 | 36 |
| berries | 96 | 72 |
| flatbread | 120 | 96 |
| grain, dried meat | never | never |

- Spoilage rate multipliers: storage basket x0.5; inside Echo Hollow or Flint Deep (cave cold storage, near the stash) x0.35; carried while hot or in a storm x1.0.
- Spoiled food becomes the item "Spoiled meat". It can be:
  - eaten (poison risk)
  - thrown as wolf bait (wolves stop to eat it for 15 s: a tactical escape)
  - used as compost on the farm in the seeds chapter (+25% growth)
  Nothing is wasted, so spoilage feels like a resource loop rather than pure loss.

Nutrition (Valheim food buffs for fun, plus Green Hell macros only on Hardcore). Three daily pips:
- Meat: meat/fish
- Plants: berries/herbs/teas
- Grain: bread/grain
Effects:
- Filling all three in one game day gives "Well fed" (+20 max stamina, hp regen x1.5 until the next day). This is the main reward.
- Hardcore adds: no Plants for 3 days gives "Weak" (stamina regen -25%); only Plants for 3 days makes hunger drain x1.3.

== 7. TEMPERATURE AND CLOTHING LAYERS ==
- Replace the binary cloak with 4 slots, each with an insulation value (0-1 total) and a wet resistance:
  - Body: Hide tunic 0.25 -> Fur cloak 0.4 (existing; the cloak now goes in this slot)
  - Legs: Hide leggings 0.15
  - Feet: Hide wraps 0.1. Also -50% sprain chance on rock and slopes, and less chill when wading.
  - Head: Fur hood 0.1
  Hide costs make hunting matter more.
- chill = base * (1 - 0.75*ins) * (wet ? 1.8 : 1) * (torch 0.75) * diffK. Existing cloak saves keep exactly today's x0.5, because ins 0.4 * 0.75 is about 0.3, then tune.
- Ambient table for the "feels like" readout:
  | Situation | Value |
  |---|---|
  | day | +15 |
  | night | 0 |
  | storm | -6 |
  | inside a cave | +8 (constant) |
  | hut | +6 |
  | house | +10 |
  | hearth | +20 |
  | fire within 8 m | +20 |
  | hot spring | +35 |
  | in water | -12 |
- Hardcore: clothing has durability. It wears from wolf bites, crawling or fractures and storms, and you repair it at the fire with hide/fibre. Optional.

== 8. INTERACTIONS WITH EXISTING SYSTEMS ==
- Poultice: as in 2b. H still applies it. In the body screen it targets the chosen wound.
- Fur cloak: becomes the Body layer. In storms it halves wetness gain (oiled fur).
- Waterskin: tracks source quality. Filling at the well is safe. "Boil" at a fire with the hide bag or pot makes it safe. R to drink a raw skin on Hardcore rolls for dysentery. The HUD chip shows the quality.
- Rest / sleep (RST system):
  - Every slept hour advances affliction healing by 2 h.
  - Fatigue goes to 0 and Dread to 0.
  - Infection progress pauses while sleeping in the house bed.
  - Resting together in the bed gives healing x1.5 (Snug tier).
  - Sleeping outside without a fire on Hardcore rolls hypothermia risk and a night wolf event.
  - The rest outcome text should name what healed ("The ankle feels stronger.").
- Cooking at the fire: the spit with doneness, plus boiling, plus teas. Sharing a meal with Sena counts toward her nutrition and is +1 Plants pip if bread.
- Drying rack: preservation (dried meat), the storm pause, and wolf theft unless fenced.
- Storage basket and caves: spoilage multipliers.
- Hot spring: cures hypothermia and Wet, doubles sprain/fracture healing while soaking, Dread -30.
- Caves: darkness feeds Dread unless a torch is lit. Bats in Flint Deep: no disease (keep it fair).
- Horses: let you travel with leg injuries. A fall from a gallop (hitting a wolf or a steep drop) can cause a sprain, or a fracture on Hardcore. Horses spook at Dread-induced phantom howls: a fun detail but optional.
- Wolves: bleeding and scent. Spoiled meat as bait. Pack size by difficulty.
- Storms: Wet. The thatch hut leaks (already -1 comfort): on Hardcore the hut also leaves you wet unless upgraded.
- Map: water sources get a safe/unsafe glyph once you have drunk there. Herb nodes appear on the map after the first pick.
- Closeness / romance: Sena tending wounds, leaning on her, comfort reducing Dread, and caring for her when she is hurt. Mature, non-explicit bonding beats.
- Lio (newlife chapter): she cannot be afflicted (keep children safe from harm mechanics). Her presence at home drains Dread strongly.

== 9. DEATH, DOWNED STATE AND PERMADEATH LEGACY ==
- DOWNED (Sons of the Forest companion revive / DayZ unconscious):
  - Trigger: hp 0 while Sena is within 40 m and able. Aro collapses (Death01 played to its midpoint, then held) for 25 s while Sena sprints over and revives him with a bandage (hp 25, bleeding stopped).
  - Hardcore: once per game day and only with a bandage or poultice in the pack; otherwise it is real death.
  - Wolves keep attacking during the downed state unless you killed the pack, so it stays tense.
- STORY: today's die().
- SURVIVOR: rescue plus the penalty in section 1.
- HARDCORE PERMADEATH:
  1. A non-graphic cinematic. Fade, Sena kneels, a short grief line. With Blood off it stays fully clean.
  2. A cairn memorial (new BUILD 'cairn': stacked stones with an ochre handprint, using the existing ochre item) at the home fire. It is visible on the map in any later run.
  3. The LEGACY screen: days survived, chapter reached, closeness, deer hunted, places found, a cause-of-death line, and a generated epitaph ("Aro, who made the first fire. He lived 23 days in the valley and was loved.").
  4. Then:
     - (a) Lio born (newlife reached) -> "Continue as Lio": a new Hardcore save in the same world, played as grown Lio with Sena, older, as the companion. Structures stay (some decay to sites), the stash is kept, map knowledge is kept, Aro's cairn is at home. Play continues as an open Legacy mode with "The Valley Remembers" goals.
     - (b) Earlier -> "The Valley Remembers": a fresh Hardcore run that starts with one heirloom perk chosen from the previous run's achievements: Fire-knower (campfire known), Tracker (deer shown on the map), Herbalist (herb nodes pre-revealed), Hunter (start with a spear). Rogue Legacy / Don't Starve style.
  5. The title screen gains "The Stones": a hall of fallen runs (local plus Mongo).
- Sena's own death: recommend that she can be Downed but never die on Survivor. On Hardcore, if she is not revived within 60 s it is game over for the run (same memorial, both names). This needs sign-off from the story/mature-themes design because it is the darkest beat. The legacy option (a) does not apply.
- Save integrity:
  - Hardcore writes S.diff.perma.
  - save.js deleteGame() is called on death, before the memorial screen.
  - The Mongo/SQLite record is flagged dead rather than deleted, so "The Stones" can read it.
  - Quitting autosaves (the visibilitychange beacon already exists at main.js:302).

== 10. KEEPING IT FUN ==
- Every affliction has: a clear cause, an early-game cure from materials found near the river start (fibre, sticks, yarrow), a timer in game hours, and a one-line tooltip.
- First occurrence: Sena explains it in-world ("Sit. Let me see that leg.") instead of a tutorial popup. Later occurrences show only an icon and a toast.
- Survivor never kills you through afflictions alone (hp floor 10). Only wolves, cold or starvation kill.
- The body screen has a "Treat all" button when you have the supplies, so admin never takes more than one click.
- Custom toggles let players mix rules (for example Hardcore without leeches).

== 11. DATA MODEL AND IMPLEMENTATION SKETCH ==
- New section `// ---------- HC survival ----------` in main.js, or a new src/survival.js that exports pure functions taking S plus deps, which is easier to unit-test.
- State: S.diff, S.aff[], S.risk{hypo, infect, para}, S.wet, S.tired, S.dread, S.nut{day, m, p, g}, S.age{}, S.skinQ, S.wear{body, legs, feet, head}, S.downedDay.
- All defaults go in fresh() and are migrated on load (old saves become Survivor or Story with afflictions empty).
- Frame order: updateStats -> updateSurvival(dt) (afflictions, risks, spoilage tick every 1 s, dread, fatigue, nutrition rollover) -> HUD icons only on change.
- Modifiers enter at:
  - updatePlayer: speed, noSprint, noJump
  - the stamina line (3669): cap and regen
  - updateStats: drain multipliers and chill
  - WPN: aimWobble, noTwoHand, damage
- Fall damage: track the peak P.pos.y while airborne and compute the drop when landing. This is new and needed for sprains and fractures.
- Test hooks: G.diff/G.setDiff, G.aff(), G.addAff(id, part, sev), G.treat(id, item), G.survival() returning the full state, and G.skipHours(h).
- No new 3D assets are required. Icons are inline SVG. The leech is a tiny dark capsule mesh attached to a calf bone via h.place. A wound decal or bandage wrap can be a simple cylinder on the shin/forearm bone with a tinted material.

== 0. What to take from other games ==
- The Last of Us: split the story into SEASONS (Summer, Autumn, Winter, Spring) and show the season on the chapter card. In its winter act the protector becomes the protected (Ellie keeps Joel alive). We mirror that: Aro nurses a wounded Sena. After the darkest stretch, give the player a quiet moment of grace (TLOU's giraffes). Here that is the spring thaw at Horse Meadow.
- RDR2: long quiet stretches, then sudden loss. An Honor-like hidden morality axis. Talk at camp and the fire. An epilogue that changes with what you did. Let chores and fire scenes breathe; never rush the quiet.
- Far Cry Primal: rival tribes; outcasts who join your village; the village grows from your choices. Our rival tribe is the Ash People, and an outcast, Tamu, comes from them.
- Kingdom Come: consequences show up LATER, not straight away. NPCs remember what you did. Time-skip fades for intimacy. (KCD shows some nudity. We do not take that.)
- Witcher 3: romance grows from many small choices across quests. Jealousy and friction are part of love. The Bloody Baron: a hard choice with no clean answer. So "share food" must cost something too.
- Mass Effect / Dragon Age / BG3:
  - APPROVAL is separate from ROMANCE.
  - Some quarrels lock romance until you mend them.
  - Romance happens at camp at night (BG3 long rest). That maps straight onto our RST rest sequence.
  - Intimacy is shown by framing, then a cut or fade.
  - Ask for consent before each step: "Kiss her / Not yet".
- Stardew / Harvest Moon:
  - hearts from small daily acts
  - scripted HEART EVENTS at thresholds
  - gift preferences
  - a marriage token (mermaid pendant / blue feather). Ours is a braided ochre cord, tied at the standing stones.
  - a spouse who drifts if neglected
- The Walking Dead (Telltale): "Sena will remember that." toasts, timed choices in tense scenes, and a choices recap at the end of each chapter.
- Ancestors: hand-off between generations. That backs up the Lio epilogue.

== 1. Characters and backstory (grown-up motives) ==
- SENA: her band starved one winter in the cold hills. Her mother gave Sena her own food and died. This drives her mercy toward the hungry. Line: "My mother gave me her share. I am alive because someone did not refuse."
- ARO: his brother Dain was killed by raiders over a carcass. This drives his urge to protect, and the temptation of revenge. It makes the choice to spare or kill Korr personal.
- KORR: leader of the ASH PEOPLE, who smear their hands grey with ash (the dark mirror of your ochre handprints). He is not a cartoon villain. His people are sick and starving, and he wants Sena because she is a HEALER. He does not want her as a possession. Keep any sexual threat out of the story entirely.
- TAMU: a young hunter Korr drove out for sharing food. He is the jealousy catalyst and the story's main death. Builds use makeHuman with grey-tinted hands/face and makeSpear.
- WENA and her son PELL: outcasts who come to the door in winter.
- Children (Pell, Lio) never suffer violence on screen, never appear dead, and are never present in any romance scene.
